name: ByteJutsu Fixed Order Fee for WooCommerce
author: ByteJutsu

sections.description:
ByteJutsu Fixed Order Fee For WooCommerce lets you add a fixed fee to WooCommerce orders, with an adjustable amount and label from the WooCommerce settings.

This plugin provides:
* A fixed fee configurable from the WooCommerce settings page.
* Options to set the fee amount and the fee label.
* The fee appears in the cart, checkout, and order totals.
* Automatically applies the fee for customers during checkout, and for admins when creating or editing orders.

Key Features:
* Adjustable fixed fee for all orders.
* Customizable fee label.
* Lightweight implementation that does not modify WooCommerce core files.

How to Use

  1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Make sure WooCommerce taxes are enabled (otherwise the Tax tab is hidden).
  3. Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Tax > Fixed order fee.
  4. Set the fixed fee amount and label, then save changes.
  5. The fee will be applied to new WooCommerce orders.

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.0 or higher.
  • WooCommerce 4.0 or higher.
  • PHP 7.0 or higher.

License

This plugin is distributed under the GPLv2 or later.
See the included license.txt file for full license text.

Support

For inquiries, feature requests, or support, please contact: contact@bytejutsu.dev
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Ensure taxes are enabled in WooCommerce so the Tax tab is visible.
  4. Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Tax > Fixed order fee to configure the fee settings.
sections.faq:
Where can I find the plugin settings?

Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Tax > Fixed order fee.
If you do not see the Tax tab, enable taxes in WooCommerce settings first.

Can I change the label of the fixed fee?

Yes. You can set the label in WooCommerce > Settings > Tax > Fixed order fee.

Can I set different fees for different products?

No. This version applies a single fixed fee to all WooCommerce orders.

Does the plugin support taxes on the fixed fee?

Currently, the fixed fee is added as non-taxable.
